importReadiness.summary: Section 3 has enough official source, GPX/OSM geometry, commute/access, facilities, rules and field-report evidence for a normalization pass. It is not ready for direct runtime import because SOK-stugan endpoint semantics, QA/currentness contradiction, Hultafors old/new shelter modeling, SOK-stugan utility access and potable-water absence remain.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 3 continues from IK Omega north of Olsfors to SOK-stugan/Nordtorp through mostly forest on a mix of gravel road, tractor road and paths. The stage passes nature-value areas and historic croft/mill context, with the main rest stop at Hultafors Vindskydd / Stora utsikten above Viaredssjön. The shelter cluster has fireplace, toilet and waste evidence, but water is untreated/unknown.
